description: Calculate Out-the-Door Las Vegas resort stay receipts including mandatory daily resort fees ($45-$55/nt), Clark County 13.38% lodging tax, self/valet parking, incidental credit card holds, and loyalty tier fee waivers (MGM Gold+, Caesars Diamond+).

base_rate.description: Advertised nightly room rate in USD (default: 200)

loyalty_tier.description: Optional loyalty tier (e.g. "MGM Rewards Gold+", "Caesars Rewards Diamond+") to waive resort fees direct.

name: calculate_vegas_resort_stay
